name: Waldhof
beschreibung: Hotel Waldhof is located in a quiet location in the Stubaital, surrounded by meadows and forests, about a twelve-minute walk from the village center. The furnishings combine traditional Tiroler hospitality with a simple, modern design. Guests can expect simple, well-kept rooms as well as a restaurant serving regional cuisine. The hotel is ideal as a starting point for hikes and excursions into the surrounding mountains.
